latest_release.name: v5.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
### Features

* Add ESM configuration for Docsify ([#2751](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2751))
* Add `navbarPreservePath` option ([#2780](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2780))
* Add collapsible root sidebar groups ([#2784](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2784))
* Normalize sidebar page links and control root chevrons ([#2790](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2790))
* Add a configurable right sidebar ([#2772](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2772))
* Add the `resultSource` option to show where search results come from ([#2767](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2767))

### Bug Fixes

* Retain response status in cached AJAX results ([#2813](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2813))
* Preserve HTML attributes on external scripts ([#2819](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2819))
* Replace stale records when saving a search index ([#2817](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2817))
* Preserve literal code block content in the search index ([#2816](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2816))
* Set `aria-expanded` on sidebar links that toggle a sub-sidebar ([#2809](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2809))
* Parse inline formatting inside bold text in search ([#2815](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2815))
* Complete loading when a nested sidebar is missing ([#2801](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2801))
* Preserve sidebar focus after navigation ([#2740](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2740))
* Preserve loose-list sidebar links when collapsed ([#2787](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2787))
* Prevent long links from causing horizontal overflow ([#2786](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2786))
* Avoid quadratic cache lookups in `slugify` ([#2783](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2783))
* Update sidebar anchor activation logic ([#2779](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2779))
* Fix the zoom-image plugin script source in the documentation ([#2776](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2776))

### Maintenance

* Update dependencies including `axios`, `brace-expansion`, `browserslist`, `cssnano`, `follow-redirects`, `handlebars`, `immutable`, `postcss`, `postcss-cli`, `postcss-selector-parser`, `qs`, `serialize-javascript`, `shell-quote`, `source-map-js`, and `vue` / `@vue/server-renderer`
* Upgrade `crowdin/github-action` from v2 to v3 ([#2824](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2824))
* Update the postinstall script ([#2791](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2791))
* Add `deed.page` to the deployment guide ([#2842](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2842))
* Add instructions for upgrading custom plugins to v5 ([#2788](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2788))
* Remove the BootCDN link from the CDN documentation ([#2831](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2831))
* Update the Showcase link in the README to use an internal anchor ([#2771](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2771))
* Update the CodeSandbox link in the README ([#2769](https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2769))

## New Contributors

* @shivanshgupta365 made their first contribution in https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2772
* @julienbusset made their first contribution in https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2788
* @puneetdixit200 made their first contribution in https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2740
* @xu91102 made their first contribution in https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2815
* @gagan-baghel made their first contribution in https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2809
* @f-o-x11 made their first contribution in https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/pull/2842

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/docsifyjs/docsify/compare/v5.0.0...v5.1.0
